name: RTI Online
description: File a Right to Information request with any central ministry or department, pay the fee online and track the reply.

name: CPGRAMS (Public Grievance Portal)
description: Lodge a complaint against any central government department or public sector body and follow it until it is closed.
agency: Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances

name: Central Vigilance Commission Complaint Portal
description: Report corruption by a central government official, including bribe demands, to the anti-corruption watchdog.

name: UMANG
description: Single app for hundreds of central and state services — EPF passbook, gas booking, pension, land records and more.
agency: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology

name: DigiLocker
description: Keep driving licence, RC, PAN, marksheets and other documents in a government-issued digital wallet accepted as valid proof.
agency: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology

name: myAadhaar / mAadhaar
description: Update your Aadhaar address, download your Aadhaar, lock biometrics and check where your Aadhaar was used.

name: National Consumer Helpline
description: Complain about a seller, e-commerce site or service provider that cheated you, delayed a refund or sold a defective product.

name: e-Daakhil
description: File a consumer court case online without visiting the commission, and track hearings.

name: National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal
description: Report online fraud, UPI scams, hacking and online harassment. Reporting financial fraud within the first hours helps freeze the money.

name: 112 India (Emergency Response Support System)
description: One number and app for police, fire and ambulance, with an SOS that shares your location.

name: SHe-Box
description: Complain about sexual harassment at the workplace, whether the workplace is government or private.
agency: Ministry of Women and Child Development

name: Childline 1098
description: Round-the-clock helpline for a child in distress — abuse, child labour, child marriage or a missing child.
agency: Ministry of Women and Child Development

name: Swachhata App
description: Photograph and report garbage, overflowing bins, open drains and public toilet problems to your city corporation.
agency: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

name: Bhu-Naksha / Land Records (DILRMP)
description: Directory of every state's land records portal for khasra, khatauni, mutation status and cadastral maps.

name: Jeevan Pramaan
description: Submit a digital life certificate for your pension from home instead of standing in a bank queue.
agency: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology

name: Mera Ration / NFSA
description: Check your ration card entitlement, find a fair price shop and use your card in any state under One Nation One Ration Card.
agency: Department of Food and Public Distribution

name: Voter Services Portal / Voter Helpline
description: Apply for a voter ID, correct your details, check your name in the roll and find your polling booth.

name: cVIGIL
description: Report money, liquor or gifts being distributed and other model code of conduct violations during elections, with photo proof.

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
description: Check if your family is eligible for free hospital treatment, make your Ayushman card and find empanelled hospitals.

name: National Scholarship Portal
description: Apply for central and state scholarships from one place and track the status of your application.
agency: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology

name: PM-KISAN
description: Check your instalment status, complete e-KYC and raise a grievance if the farmer income support has not reached you.
agency: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

name: EPFiGMS
description: Complain when your provident fund is not deposited, a withdrawal is stuck or a transfer claim is rejected.

name: Income Tax e-Filing
description: File your income tax return, check refund status and raise a grievance about a demand or refund.

name: RBI Complaint Management System
description: Escalate a complaint against a bank, NBFC or payment operator to the RBI Ombudsman when the bank does not resolve it.

name: Parivahan Sewa / mParivahan
description: Apply for a driving licence, transfer vehicle ownership, pay road tax and carry a valid digital RC and licence.
agency: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
